local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local points={{util.vector3(2826.7,10267,-1440),util.vector3(2901.1,10368.1,-1440),util.vector3(3100,10368.4,-1390),util.vector3(3336.9,10368.8,-1440)}}
local step=1
local frames=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frames=frames+1
 if frames%5==0 then print('Sanctum departure pos '..tostring(self.position)..' yaw='..camera.getYaw()) end
 assert(Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current>0,'Player died on Sanctum departure')
 if frames==5 then print('Sanctum departure ready') end
 if step<=#points then
  local d=points[step]-self.position
  if math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)<25 then
   print('Sanctum departure waypoint '..step..' reached') step=step+1
  else
   local c=camera.getPosition()
   local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(util.vector3(c.x+d.x,c.y+d.y,c.z))
   local angle=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z)
   print(string.format('Sanctum departure waypoint %d aim x=%d y=%d',step,math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(angle*5120+.5))),math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*5120+.5)))
  end
 end
end}}}}
